items.title: Henry A. "Hank" Kmen Interview, 1963-02-13
items.q: Never played with him, no, no, never. Never did.

ctx.x: That was a distinction, Dixieland kind of thing. Usually came in on the trio movement, one of these march type things.
Did you play much with Foss in bands with him? Never played with him, no, no, never.
